name: io.github.Servosity/datto-bcdr-mcp
title: Datto BCDR MCP
description: Sync your whole Datto BCDR fleet into local SQLite and answer the questions the per-appliance

environmentVariables.name: DATTO_BCDR_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL for the Datto BCDR API. Leave the prefilled default unless your account uses a different regional or self-hosted host.

environmentVariables.name: DATTO_BCDR_PUBLIC_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Set the DATTO_BCDR_PUBLIC_KEY credential for the Datto BCDR MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: DATTO_BCDR_SECRET_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Set the DATTO_BCDR_SECRET_KEY credential for the Datto BCDR MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: DATTO_BCDR_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http. Not needed for the default local stdio transport.

environmentVariables.name: DATTO_BCDR_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on Datto BCDR requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own built-in User-Agent.

environmentVariables.name: PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Only used when the MCP server is bound to a tenant-gated Printing Press client profile; leave blank otherwise.
